raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "3.0.11"
  build_number: 1

recipe:
  name: pkgconf-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/pkgconf/pkgconf/archive/pkgconf-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d2c8a0965d5b80dcc454cc999ad5edb8bfbc4d8e65cde7a6f19a5cb7ecaf3377

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: pkgconf-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - meson
        - ninja
    build:
      script:
        file: build

  - package:
      name: libpkgconf
    inherit: pkgconf-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run_constraints:
        # older pkgconf packages ship the libpkgconf files themselves
        - pkgconf ==${{ version }} *_${{ build_number }}
    build:
      files:
        - if: linux
          then:
            - lib/libpkgconf.so.*
        - if: osx
          then:
            - lib/libpkgconf.*.dylib
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/pkgconf-*.dll
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          # lib: would also require the import library on Windows,
          # which lives in libpkgconf-devel; the dll is pkgconf-<soversion>.dll
          files:
            - if: linux
              then:
                - lib/libpkgconf.so.*
            - if: osx
              then:
                - lib/libpkgconf.*.dylib
            - if: win
              then:
                - Library/bin/pkgconf-*.dll

  - package:
      name: libpkgconf-devel
    inherit: pkgconf-build
    build:
      files:
        - include/pkgconf/**
        - lib/pkgconfig/libpkgconf.pc
        - Library/include/pkgconf/**
        - Library/lib/pkgconfig/libpkgconf.pc
        - if: linux
          then:
            - lib/libpkgconf.so
        - if: osx
          then:
            - lib/libpkgconf.dylib
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/lib/pkgconf.lib
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpkgconf', exact=True) }}
      run_constraints:
        # older pkgconf packages ship the libpkgconf files themselves
        - pkgconf ==${{ version }} *_${{ build_number }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpkgconf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - pkgconf/libpkgconf/libpkgconf.h
          files:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - lib/pkgconfig/libpkgconf.pc
              else:
                - Library/lib/pkgconfig/libpkgconf.pc

  - package:
      name: pkgconf
    inherit: pkgconf-build
    build:
      string: ${{ "pkg_config_" if compat == "yes" else "" }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      variant:
        use_keys:
          - compat
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if compat == "no" else 0 }}
      files:
        include:
          - bin/**
          - share/**
          - etc/conda/**
          - Library/bin/*.exe
          - Library/share/**
        exclude:
          - Library/bin/pkgconf-*.dll
          # compat links are installed by the staging build
          - if: compat != "yes"
            then:
              - bin/pkg-config
              - bin/*-pkg-config
              - Library/bin/pkg-config.exe
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpkgconf', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpkgconf', exact=True) }}
      run_constraints:
        - if: compat == "yes"
          then:
            # pkg-config symlinks clash with files from the pkg-config package
            - pkg-config <0a0
    tests:
      - script:
          - pkgconf --help
          - pkgconf --variable pc_path pkg-config
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/bin/pkgconf.bin
              - if: compat == "yes"
                then:
                  - test -L $PREFIX/bin/pkg-config
                  - pkg-config --variable pc_path pkg-config
                else:
                  - test ! -e $PREFIX/bin/pkg-config
            else:
              - if: compat == "yes"
                then:
                  - pkg-config --variable pc_path pkg-config
                else:
                  - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\pkg-config.exe exit 1
              - if not exist %PREFIX%\etc\conda\activate.d\pkgconf_activate.bat exit 1
              - if not exist %PREFIX%\etc\conda\deactivate.d\pkgconf_deactivate.bat exit 1

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: package compiler and linker metadata toolkit
  homepage: https://github.com/pkgconf/pkgconf
  repository: https://github.com/pkgconf/pkgconf

extra:
  feedstock-name: pkgconf
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danielnachun
    - isuruf
